current_step.title: Assessment Methodology Complete
current_step.action: All methodology phases for the defined scope have been executed.
current_step.rationale: Every tactical assessment step has been completed or addressed. Run 'report' to generate the final audit report.
commands: echo '[+] Assessment Complete. Run report command to export final Markdown report.'

completed_steps.title: Interactive Shell & User Context Discovery
completed_steps.action: Inspect current user ID, shell environment, and basic operating system release
completed_steps.purpose: Identify current user permissions, working directory, and environment variables.
completed_steps.rationale: In local shell and CTF challenges (e.g. pwn.college, container labs), establishing the current UID/GID, user groups, and current directory is essential before locating flags or running binaries.
completed_steps.expected_output: Current username, UID/GID, kernel version, and listing of current directory files.

completed_steps.title: Flag Artifact & Challenge Directory Location
completed_steps.action: Search common challenge paths for flag files and challenge binaries
completed_steps.purpose: Locate /flag, /challenge, or challenge-specific files and inspect their permissions.
completed_steps.rationale: Determine if the flag is directly readable or if permissions/ownership restrict read access to root or a specific challenge group.
completed_steps.expected_output: Permissions of /flag and any executables located inside /challenge.

completed_steps.title: Sudo Rules & Elevated Privilege Audit
completed_steps.action: Inspect sudo permissions and NOPASSWD entries for current user
completed_steps.purpose: Identify if current user can execute commands as root or other privileged users without password.
completed_steps.rationale: Checking 'sudo -l' is the quickest path to privilege escalation or flag reading if sudo rules exist.
completed_steps.expected_output: List of allowed commands for current user or prompt indicating sudo restrictions.

completed_steps.title: SUID/SGID Binaries & Linux Capabilities Audit
completed_steps.action: Search for binaries with SUID bit or elevated file capabilities
completed_steps.purpose: Discover custom challenge binaries or GTFOBins vectors that execute with effective root UID.
completed_steps.rationale: CTF challenges (especially pwn.college and binary exploitation) frequently use SUID binaries (e.g., in /challenge/ or /usr/bin) to grant temporary root privileges to read /flag.

completed_steps.title: Challenge Binary Analysis & Decompilation Preparation
completed_steps.action: Inspect challenge executable metadata, string tables, and dynamic libraries
completed_steps.purpose: Analyze binary architecture, symbols, and hardcoded secrets.
completed_steps.rationale: Extract readable strings and binary metadata to understand required input arguments, environment variables, or logic checks.
completed_steps.expected_output: ASCII strings, function symbols, or assembly disassembly preview.

completed_steps.title: Background Processes & Cron Task Enumeration
completed_steps.action: Inspect running processes, listening internal ports, and scheduled cron jobs
completed_steps.purpose: Find background scripts or internal services running under higher privileges.
completed_steps.rationale: Check for root cronjobs or background daemons that may read or generate flags.
completed_steps.expected_output: Process table, cron jobs, and open sockets.

completed_steps.title: Assessment Evidence Archiving & Chain of Custody Proof
completed_steps.action: Consolidate tool execution logs, discovered credential hashes, and configuration artifacts into evidence vault
completed_steps.rationale: Ensure all technical findings possess immutable timestamps and execution proof for the final compliance audit report.
commands: echo '[+] Consolidating local execution evidence into .assessments/ archive...'
completed_steps.expected_output: Archived evidence bundle with cryptographic integrity verification.
completed_steps.risk_assessment: Internal local filesystem operation. Zero network risk.

execution.command: echo '[+] Consolidating local execution evidence into .assessments/ archive...'

completed_steps.title: Assessment Artifact & Temporary Credential Cleanup
completed_steps.action: Purge temporary test files, created staging users, and reset modified configuration parameters
completed_steps.rationale: Rules of Engagement mandate complete sanitization of test artifacts to return client infrastructure to baseline.
commands: echo '[+] Cleaning up temporary assessment test artifacts and local cache...'
completed_steps.expected_output: Confirmation that temporary test artifacts have been removed from the environment.
